_meta.name: Warli spelling correction / normalization table (seed)
_meta.description: wrong -> correct Warli spelling pairs. In the real project these come from the annotated audio recording (voice_recording.*) where incorrect Warli spellings are marked alongside the correct one. This table is applied AFTER dictionary lookup to auto-fix common mis-transliterations. It is a correction/validation dataset, NOT ASR training data.
_meta.status: SEED. Replace/extend `pairs` with the annotations transcribed from voice_recording.*.

pair_fields.wrong: Incorrectly spelled/transliterated Warli token (as it may slip through lookup or manual entry).
pair_fields.source: Where the correction came from, e.g. 'voice_recording:03:12' (timestamp) or 'manuscript'.

pairs.note: Marathi nasalization normalized to Warli form.
